step.cmd: Log in to the SMS web application.
On the top navigation menu, click Reports.

info.p: The Reports page is displayed with a list of previously generated reports.

step.cmd: Click CREATE REPORT on the top right of the page.

info.p: The Create report window is displayed.

step.cmd: Enter a name for the report.
Choose the day when you want to receive the report from the Schedule drop-down list.

info.note: Note: You can select one or more days from the list. The report will be sent at 8 AM GMT on the selected day every week.

step.cmd: Select the motor’s location, plant, and process from the respective fields.
Select a specific motor or select All motors from the Motor drop-down list if you want to generate a report about all motors belonging to a process.

result.p: The new report will be added to the list on the Reports page.
result.note: Note: You will not be able to view the report until the selected day of the report.
